about: Kimberly R. McGhee is a partner at The Estate Lawyers, APC, a California probate litigation and trust litigation boutique based in San Diego, representing trustees, fiduciaries, families, and beneficiaries in trust contests, will contests, breach of fiduciary duty actions, inheritance disputes, financial elder abuse cases, and contested conservatorship matters throughout San Diego County, Orange County, and across California. Kim holds dual specialist credentials: Certified Elder Law Attorney (CELA®, National Elder Law Foundation, 2018) and California State Bar Certified Specialist in Estate Planning, Trust and Probate Law (2018). Admitted to the California State Bar in 2011, she is also admitted to the Ninth Circuit and U.S. District Court for the District of Nevada, and the Nevada State Bar (2005), and has been selected to the Southern California Super Lawyers list in Trust and Estate Litigation every year from 2021 through 2026. She serves on TEXCOM, the Thomson Reuters Practical Law Trusts & Estates Advisory Board, and the boards of Palomar Health Medical Group and Southern Caregiver Resource Center.
